## History

Lorenzo White had seven daughters before the birth of his first son. During a canvassing visit by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), he was overjoyed by his newborn son and contributed handsomely to their fundraising efforts.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P40](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0040), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P46](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0046), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P55](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0055), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P57](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0057)_
